image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a small, pale cream-colored coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing among dark soil, pine needles, and small green leaves. The fungus features a dense cluster of short, upright branches with rounded tips, emerging from a common base obscured by debris.
